verdict.rationale: Rive is a cloud-backed design and animation editor that stores user files and revision history, so data region or residency is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains nothing about choosing a storage region or data residency. Revision-history autosave describes storage behavior, not where data is located, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
